label: SIMULATED TRAFFIC — Playwright persona bots, not humans. Demonstration of the pipeline; outcomes follow the persona model, not evidence about real users. Lift is a function of the assumed share of keyboard, screen-reader and low-vision users.
personaMixNote: Assumed mix is a modelling choice (mouse 70%, keyboard 10%, screen-reader 10%, low-vision 10%), not measured traffic. realisedMix is this run's actual draws. Win threshold is 95%.
personasNote: local visit log, n=400; Flagsmith counted n=400
outcome: Flagsmith completed the experiment and rolled out treatment.
honesty: Barrier flags are wired on the site; this run used the bundled checkout_a11y native experiment. Sequential per-barrier experiments are the attribution path.

headline.copy: Flagsmith lift (SIMULATED traffic, assumed mix 70/10/10/10): 33.6%, P(win) 99.9%, 95% CI +11.6% to +55.5%, rolled out

notes: All traffic is SIMULATED (Playwright persona bots, not humans). Outcomes follow the persona model, not evidence about real users.

barriers.title: Hover-only checkout menu
barriers.control: Checkout lives in a CSS :hover mega-menu. It is display:none until pointer hover, so it is not focusable and not in the accessibility tree.
barriers.treatment: Menu opens on focus and keyboard activation; Checkout is a real link.

barriers.title: Unlabeled icon button
barriers.control: Cart / continue control is a glyph with no accessible name.
barriers.treatment: Button has aria-label="View cart and check out".

barriers.title: Non-focusable div used as Place order
barriers.control: Place order is a clickable div with no role, tabindex, or name.

barriers.wcag: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships / 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions
barriers.title: Form fields without labels
barriers.control: Email and card fields have placeholders only, no <label> or aria-label.
barriers.treatment: Every input has a visible associated label.

barriers.wcag: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value / 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
barriers.title: Terms checkbox with no accessible name
barriers.control: The terms checkbox is an unlabeled input; the adjacent span is not associated via label/for or aria-labelledby.
barriers.treatment: A <label for="terms"> wraps the terms copy.

barriers.title: Low-contrast terms copy
barriers.control: Terms checkbox label is grey-on-grey (~1.4:1). The contrast-threshold persona will not agree to unread terms.
